2610.09763.title: Beyond Policy Support: Interaction Constrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
2610.09763.paper_summary: Offline reinforcement learning enables reward-driven policy improvement from fixed datasets without requiring online exploration, making it particularly attractive in safety-critical domains. A central challenge, however, is distribution shift: policy optimization may favor actions that are weakly supported by the offline data, rendering value estimates unreliable. Existing approaches primarily control this shift in the policy's own action space. In interactive environments such as autonomous driving, this can be insufficient: a candidate ego trajectory may remain well supported under the marginal behavior distribution while being poorly supported jointly with the surrounding-agent behavior observed in the logged interaction. We refer to this degradation in interaction support as \emph{interaction distribution shift} (IDS), and introduce \emph{Interaction-Constrained Drive Policy} (ICDP), an offline reinforcement learning framework that explicitly controls interaction-level distribution shift. Starting from the joint data distribution over ego and surrounding-agent futures, we show that joint-support degradation decomposes exactly into an ego-support component and a residual interaction-support component. We recover the latter through contrastive density-ratio estimation, isolating interaction compatibility without explicit joint-density modeling, surrounding-agent prediction, or rollouts in reactive simulators or learned world models during policy optimization. Closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan, Interplan and real-world truck experiments show that ICDP suppresses high-value yet interaction-unsupported trajectory selections and improves performance in interaction-critical driving scenarios. Project webpage: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/
2610.09763.paper_summary_zh: 離線強化學習能夠從固定數據集中進行獎勵驅動的策略改進，而無需在線探索，這使其在安全關鍵領域中特別具有吸引力。 然而，一個主要挑戰是分佈轉移：策略優化可能偏向於那些在離線數據中支持較弱的行動，導致價值估計不可靠。 現有的方法主要控制策略自身行動空間中的這種轉移。 在自動駕駛等互動環境中，這可能是不足夠的：候選的自我軌跡可能在邊際行為分佈下仍然得到良好支持，但在與記錄的互動中觀察到的周圍代理行為共同支持的情況下卻支持不佳。 我們將這種互動支持的退化稱為\emph{互動分佈轉移}（IDS），並引入\emph{互動約束駕駛策略}（ICDP），這是一種明確控制互動級別分佈轉移的離線強化學習框架。 從自我和周圍代理未來的聯合數據分佈開始，我們展示了聯合支持的退化恰好分解為自我支持組件和殘餘互動支持組件。 我們通過對比密度比估計恢復後者，隔離互動兼容性，而無需在策略優化過程中進行明確的聯合密度建模、周圍代理預測或在反應模擬器或學習的世界模型中進行回放。 在nuPlan、Interplan和現實世界卡車實驗中的閉環評估顯示，ICDP抑制了高價值但互動不支持的軌跡選擇，並改善了在互動關鍵駕駛場景中的性能。 項目網頁：https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/
